name: Fuuma Jinja
source:
Youkai sealed for 1000 years is now released in the peaceful city. An ordinary high school student receives guidance from a shine maiden and takes a sword to fight the demon.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一只遭封印长达1000年的妖怪如今重获自由，平静的城市也因此陷入危机。一名平凡的高中生在巫女指引下拿起宝剑，踏上了与妖魔交战的道路。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
